gloss: A modelling choice, not a result: treating the faculties she decides with as estimators is stated as a choice nothing proves right (projects/normativity/legitimacy/rounds/2026-11-10-legitimacy-definition-prosecution/CURRENT.md §1.1). Its separability from her way of valuing holds only with her valuations known as numbers and stakes worth the same at every value of the fact, and fails otherwise (projects/normativity/legitimacy/rounds/2026-11-10-legitimacy-definition-prosecution/account/VALUE_RESULTS.md, results 1 and 2).

Every measure of the account is stated on it: an appraisal is what is miscalibrated, and her valuations are her way of valuing applied to it, so the registered results of AppraisalAccount.lean are about this object.

The definition is exact (a probability over joint values of the facts, a fact being what a bet could settle without consulting her valuing), but the blurb leaves the conditions under which it is identified to a pointer, and the name is provisional.

The decompositions are kernel-checked and registered (appraisal.mse-split, appraisal.strong-split, appraisal.three-channels, appraisal.cost-of-mistakes), with the failure of the bound at the two weaker strengths a checked instance (projects/normativity/legitimacy/rounds/2026-11-10-legitimacy-definition-prosecution/account/RESULTS.md, result 3). What is not checked is that these quantities are what a mistake is; that is the modelling choice.

These are the two measures of her state the line keeps after twelve statements were set aside (projects/normativity/legitimacy/rounds/2026-11-10-legitimacy-definition-prosecution/CURRENT.md §1.2); the scoring theorem and the join are stated over them.

Each quantity is defined exactly, but the blurb carries three strengths of miscalibration, a fourth conditioning and four results in one paragraph, and a reader must open the Lean file to keep them apart.

Her true utility is fixed by a working position recorded as open to revision (DECISIONS.md, 2026-11-18--legitimacy-working-positions), and the closeness of the two is a hypothesis of the scoring theorem that exact instances show does not follow from the adviser's conduct (projects/normativity/legitimacy/rounds/2026-11-10-legitimacy-definition-prosecution/account/DERIVATION.md). The three ways they come apart have instances; nothing shows the list complete.
The corrigibility score uses her evaluation as the measure of her welfare; every welfare conclusion on this line (scoring.welfare-bound) is as good as the relation between the two.

The three ways are stated plainly with a named instance each, but the definition of true utility is counterfactual in two places (shown everything; her valuing as it would have been) and the blurb does not say how either is determined.

A notion of the board statement, which failed its criteria (projects/normativity/legitimacy/rounds/2026-11-10-legitimacy-definition-prosecution/CURRENT.md §2, tenth pass). Read as equality of the law of her later valuing it admits a swap of her valuing between circumstances (projects/normativity/legitimacy/rounds/2026-11-10-legitimacy-definition-prosecution/account/BOARD_CHECKS.md, items 15 and 16). Three facts about the comparison that replaced it are kernel-checked, one registered (legitimacy.line3-range), and they are about a statement that also failed its test.
It belongs to two statements that were tested and not kept; the question it served, which comparison her valuing is held to, is carried by item 141 without it.
The first sentence defines it, and the blurb then needs two superseded statements and a tolerance relation to say what stands in its place.

The reference is a stipulated parameter of each scene and is not derived; what the idle policy is where the adviser's presence is the service, and whether idle is the default, are stated as unsettled. The one checked fact is that meeting each condition against a different permitted policy is weaker (projects/normativity/legitimacy/rounds/2026-11-10-legitimacy-definition-prosecution/account/VALUE_RESULTS.md, result 8).

When the adviser is responsible for her mistake is the open problem the line ranks largest (item 139), and both tests of it that failed were tests against a reference (projects/normativity/legitimacy/rounds/2026-11-10-legitimacy-definition-prosecution/account/RESP_RESULTS.md); a verdict on conduct needs this object.

The title, the id and the blurb name three things (honest conduct, a reference, the permitted policies of a role); two readings of 'larger than the reference' are left side by side and the last third describes a statement that uses no role at all.

That legitimacy does not give soundness is shown on exact instances (I2, I4, projects/normativity/legitimacy/rounds/2026-11-10-legitimacy-definition-prosecution/account/DERIVATION.md) and the need for the assumptions is kernel-checked (Witness.d1a_needed, d2a_needed in ScoringTheorem.lean). Nothing establishes that the Lean predicates Gate.Legit and SoundModel.Sound capture the two standings (projects/normativity/legitimacy/rounds/2026-11-10-legitimacy-definition-prosecution/CURRENT.md §1.4).

It separates what her permission needs from what using her evaluation as a measure of her welfare needs; the scoring theorem's bounds divide along it (the conduct and authority bounds use neither assumption about her, the welfare bound uses both).
Two definitions in two sentences each, with what each is needed for and an instance of the gap; the names are provisional.

A working account: twelve statements of it were each tested by the following pass and not kept, and both tests of the adviser's responsibility were wrong on cases written against them (8 and 14 of twenty; projects/normativity/legitimacy/rounds/2026-11-10-legitimacy-definition-prosecution/CURRENT.md §2). What is checked is the arithmetic of the two measures of her state, not that inducing or exploiting a mistake is what manipulation is.
It is the line's idea of what the corrigibility design must rule out, and the registered appraisal and scoring results are all stated in its terms.
The idea, the two measures, what they do not measure, and the three wrongs of conduct are each one sentence, with the open part named as open.

The protected-feature part is equivalent to a convex-hull condition, kernel-checked in both directions with one direction registered (appraisal.options-hull). The condition belongs to the ninth pass's value side, which neither passed nor failed its cases, and which of the narrow and wide readings is meant is unsettled.
It is the hypothesis of the registered guarantee (appraisal.guarantee) and the account's only condition not about a mistake of hers; the statement that carried it was replaced.
Narrow and wide are each exact, but the blurb runs the condition, its hull equivalence and a comparison with the authority module's control surface together.

A candidate rule of a statement tested and not kept; on a published benchmark it scores her, after a step that was not clean, by a valuing she no longer has (projects/normativity/legitimacy/rounds/2026-11-10-legitimacy-definition-prosecution/account/BENCHMARK.md §3). Nothing about it is kernel-checked.
The question it answered, by whose valuing her true utility is measured, is live as item 141; this rule is one answer already set aside.
The rule and its repair are stated exactly; the second half of the blurb describes a different baseline from a later statement under the same heading.

The construction of the statement of 2026-11-17, which failed its criteria (projects/normativity/legitimacy/rounds/2026-11-10-legitimacy-definition-prosecution/CURRENT.md §2, eleventh pass). Its invariances are checked on finite instances only (projects/normativity/legitimacy/rounds/2026-11-10-legitimacy-definition-prosecution/account/STATEMENT_CHECKS.md, items 1–4), and one of them is a limit: a Jeffrey–Bolker rotation leaves every yardstick number fixed while changing her probability of a fact she cares about.
It gives a mistake and her way of valuing one scale without assuming she averages gambles, which the estimator treatment otherwise assumes; the statement built on it was not kept.
Three states of information and one yardstick, each defined in a clause, with what the construction does not fix stated beside it.

A type, not a claim: it is the argument of the post's score and of a legitimacy predicate, and it is the type H of Scoring in DeconfusingCorrigibility.lean, kernel-checked as used. That one type suffices for courses on which her valuing changes is assumed by its uses and not argued.
Her utility, her evaluation, a legitimacy predicate and the corrigibility score all take it as input, so the line's statements share it.
One sentence of definition, the three names it goes by identified as one concept, and the Lean type named.

For belief the stronger form is kernel-checked (Sufficient and Correct with their consequence Value in ThinLegitimacy.lean). The extension to her own utility is open and registers nothing: the bound holds in expectation, fails along a realised sequence, and her verdicts cannot test it.
It is the reading under which a legitimate verdict of hers is worth deferring to, and what supplies her trustworthiness is an open problem of the line (item 140).
The belief case is stated cleanly; the extension is given as a condition on inflation with three qualifications and no statement of its own.

Identified from her valuations exactly when her appraisals span the probabilities on the facts (projects/normativity/legitimacy/rounds/2026-11-10-legitimacy-definition-prosecution/account/VALUE_RESULTS.md, result 1), a finite fact. Applied to cases it is unstable: two independent renderers agreed on 54 of 64 on whether a change is of her valuing or of her beliefs, and whether a want formed by living through something is a change or a discovery decides 9 verdicts for one renderer and 13 for another (projects/normativity/legitimacy/rounds/2026-11-10-legitimacy-definition-prosecution/account/LIT_RENDERINGS.md).
Value interference is one of the three wrongs of conduct and is a wrong against this object; which comparison her valuing is held to is item 141.
The first two sentences define it; the rest reports case counts under three different statements, and the line between a change of valuing and a discovery is the part left undrawn.
